AGRICULTURE — TERMLY EXAM #11 (TERM 2)
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 60 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. About how big should a planting hole for a fruit tree be? (1 mark)
   A. About 1 cm
   B. About half a metre wide and deep
   C. As big as a football field
   D. 10 cm wide only

2. Why should young fruit trees be watered in dry weather? (1 mark)
   A. Water kills them
   B. They do not need water
   C. Their roots are small and cannot reach much water
   D. Water makes fruit sour

3. Why should fruit be washed before eating? (1 mark)
   A. To make it dry
   B. To remove dirt and germs
   C. To make it sour
   D. To change its colour

4. Why should you avoid climbing thin branches while harvesting? (1 mark)
   A. They are too sweet
   B. They can break and you may fall
   C. They are too high
   D. They are cold

5. Why should a poultry house be clean and dry? (1 mark)
   A. To make eggs blue
   B. To keep birds healthy and safe
   C. To attract rats
   D. To stop hens from laying

6. How does manure from animals help crops? (1 mark)
   A. It makes crops small
   B. It scares birds
   C. It supplies plant food to the soil
   D. It gives shade

7. Which nutrient in milk builds strong bones and teeth? (1 mark)
   A. Salt
   B. Sugar
   C. Calcium
   D. Starch

8. Who should be called when a cow is sick? (1 mark)
   A. A veterinary officer
   B. A tailor
   C. A carpenter
   D. A driver

9. Which of these fruits is a protective food? (1 mark)
   A. Butter
   B. Chapati
   C. Rice
   D. Orange

10. Which is a cheap way of getting a balanced meal? (1 mark)
   A. Grow vegetables and fruits at home
   B. Skip meals
   C. Eat only sweets
   D. Buy only expensive foods

11. Which group does githeri belong to mainly? (1 mark)
   A. Drinks
   B. Energy and body-building
   C. Only water
   D. Only protective

12. Which local vegetable is a protective food? (1 mark)
   A. Ugali
   B. Managu
   C. Butter
   D. Rice

13. What should you do if oil in a pan catches fire? (1 mark)
   A. An adult covers the pan with a lid and turns off the heat
   B. Pour water on it
   C. Carry the pan outside quickly
   D. Blow on it

14. What should you hold hot pots with? (1 mark)
   A. Paper
   B. A wet cloth
   C. Bare hands
   D. A dry cloth or oven gloves

15. Why should food be dry before it is put into hot oil? (1 mark)
   A. Water makes hot oil splash
   B. Water makes food sweet
   C. Water makes oil colourless
   D. Water makes oil cold

16. What should you do first for a small burn? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore it
   B. Put butter on it
   C. Cool it under running clean water for at least ten minutes
   D. Cover with toothpaste

17. What is a tippy tap? (1 mark)
   A. A type of soap
   B. A cooking pot
   C. A toothbrush
   D. A simple hand-washing device made from a container

18. How should drinking water be stored? (1 mark)
   A. On the ground
   B. With a dirty cup
   C. In a clean container with a lid
   D. In an open basin

19. Why should you wash hands after removing gloves? (1 mark)
   A. Gloves are heavy
   B. Gloves are wet
   C. Hands may still have germs
   D. To dry the gloves

20. Why is a tippy tap useful? (1 mark)
   A. It works without a water tap and saves water
   B. It cleans clothes
   C. It needs electricity
   D. It makes soap

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
21. Give three good personal hygiene practices apart from washing hands. (3 marks)

22. Explain how good personal hygiene helps prevent diseases such as diarrhoea. (4 marks)

23. Give three uses of chickens. (3 marks)

24. List four basic needs of domestic animals. (4 marks)

25. Name the three main food groups and one example of each. (3 marks)

26. Describe how to plant a fruit seedling. (4 marks)

27. Describe how to boil eggs. (4 marks)

28. Name three foods that can be shallow fried. (3 marks)

29. How can a family get a balanced meal cheaply? (2 marks)
pages.answers:
AGRICULTURE — TERMLY EXAM #11 (TERM 2) · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. B — About half a metre wide and deep
   The hole gives roots space in loose soil.

2. C — Their roots are small and cannot reach much water
   Young trees are easily stressed by drought.

3. B — To remove dirt and germs
   Clean fruit is safe to eat.

4. B — They can break and you may fall
   Safety while picking fruit.

5. B — To keep birds healthy and safe
   Dirty houses spread diseases.

6. C — It supplies plant food to the soil
   Manure enriches the soil.

7. C — Calcium
   Milk has calcium and protein.

8. A — A veterinary officer
   A vet treats sick animals.

9. D — Orange
   Fruits are protective foods.

10. A — Grow vegetables and fruits at home
   A kitchen garden gives fresh food.

11. B — Energy and body-building
   Maize gives energy, beans give protein.

12. B — Managu
   Managu is a green leafy vegetable.

13. A — An adult covers the pan with a lid and turns off the heat
   Water makes an oil fire worse.

14. D — A dry cloth or oven gloves
   Wet cloth lets heat through.

15. A — Water makes hot oil splash
   Splashing oil can burn.

16. C — Cool it under running clean water for at least ten minutes
   Cooling reduces burn damage.

17. D — A simple hand-washing device made from a container
   A tippy tap uses little water.

18. C — In a clean container with a lid
   Covering keeps germs out.

19. C — Hands may still have germs
   Germs can get on hands.

20. A — It works without a water tap and saves water
   It can be made from a jerrican.

SECTION B
----
21. (3 marks)
   Answer: Bathing daily, brushing teeth twice a day, keeping nails short, wearing clean clothes, drinking safe water (any three).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

22. (4 marks)
   Answer: Washing hands removes germs before they reach the mouth. Safe water and clean food stop germs entering the body. Using the toilet and washing hands afterwards stops germs from spreading.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct point.

23. (3 marks)
   Answer: Eggs, meat, manure, feathers and income (any three).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each use.

24. (4 marks)
   Answer: Clean water, enough feed, clean shelter, health care and kind handling.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each need.

25. (3 marks)
   Answer: Energy-giving: ugali; body-building: beans; protective: sukuma wiki (or other correct examples).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each group with example.

26. (4 marks)
   Answer: Water the seedling; remove the bag carefully; place at the same depth in the hole; fill with soil and firm; water and mulch.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each for four correct steps.

27. (4 marks)
   Answer: Put eggs in a pot, cover with cold water, bring to the boil, boil gently for about 10 minutes, cool in cold water and peel.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each of four steps.

28. (3 marks)
   Answer: Eggs, fish, sausages, onions, chapati (any three).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each food.

29. (2 marks)
   Answer: Grow vegetables and fruits at home and use cheap proteins such as beans, omena or eggs.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.
